from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-317a13a5.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the largest 4-connected object of the dominant foreground color,
    # using the isolated color marker as its replacement.
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [v for v, n in counts.items() if v != bg and n == 1]
    replacement = markers[0] if markers else None
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # Most frequent non-background color is the object color; transform its largest component.
    fg=Counter(v for v in counts if v != bg)
    target=max(fg, key=lambda v: fg[v])
    candidates=[cells for color,cells in comps if color==target]
    chosen=max(candidates,key=len)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in chosen: out[r][c]=replacement
    return out
'''
